external_plan.method: Continuous swept-solid tests against the complete original, actual nominal retained stock, fixed additions and every not-yet-removed support. Conservative convex bounds are used where sufficient; the initial solid plus a checked bound for every swept boundary-triangle prism covers nonconvex translations without a Boolean union; any conservative padding and serialization coverage allowance are included in the summed complete-scene intersection bound. Extracted siblings are omitted only after their certified complete exits. Actual added underside finishing stock excludes the unchanged original under explicit partition and physical-state identity proofs.
limits: No physical force, breaking, cure or resin-strength test.
Cut locations and kerfs are specified. Full cutter bodies, handles, fingers and actual access force are not certified.
Nominal cut planes define this removal state; maximum cut stumps are checked separately for rotation/internal service.
external_plan.partition_index_field: Each fragment body_section_index identifies its original ordered nonempty partition fragment; fragment list order is the actual extraction order.
external_plan.candidate_family_order: Explicit residual instructions are revalidated first. Only the bound fine partition menu is then searched through unchanged endpoint/stock/kerf/sequential-sibling/sweep/exit gates. No whole-body discovery or additional generic cut menu is searched.
external_plan.phase_scope: The prior complete proof is byte-verified and its exact residual scene is recreated. All new cuts, sibling states, continuous sweeps and full exits use unchanged gates. This process changes candidate scheduling only; unresolved IDs remain explicit.
external_plan.zero_motion_pruning_scope: One outer make_plan attempt only; exact original/context/piece identities with strong references. A single supplied convex hull must exceed the unchanged collision tolerance at zero motion. Clear or invalid prechecks always fall through to the original continuous verifier; actual-stock boundary-prism checks and final exits are unchanged.

holder_finite_endpoint_state_binding.pre_cut_identity: For every newly adopted definition, its unchanged full support is still active and contains both old and new caps. Thus F union old_cap and F union new_cap have the same occupied state within the stated unchanged bound.

external_plan.tight_continuous_prism_scope: Actual signed starting stock and every boundary triangle remain covered; raw and reloaded exact ideal-vertex halfspace proofs and the unchanged complete-scene summed collision gate remain required. This changes analysis bounds only, not printed or cut stock.

fine_partition_search.later_pose_distances: min(leg,.8/1.6/3.2/6.4/12.8mm) and leg end; rejection only

streamed_boundary_verifier.fragment_candidate_schedule: Existing exact direct routes, then the existing short-departure family for each actual fine fragment; whole-body discovery remains disabled.

fixed_micro_instruction: Blue fixed micro-reinforcements are permanent. Do not cut.
